name: Wake never expands authority
statement: A recovery trigger, native host, optional supervisor or fresh extension installation may not silently authorize new filesystem roots, enable arbitrary execution, bypass pairing, expose credentials to webpages or transfer machine-specific grants to another identity or device.
changePolicy: Every replacement must prove authenticated identity binding, scope preservation, revocation and negative cases.

provenance.sourceReference: Owner companion recovery design 2026-10-15; Chute Windows v2.6.1 RC1 historical reference
